scope: Read-only review of offline.py, offline_test.py, and protocol.json at base 9730d49b0984a47cdc48ac809b6c754a3057b0a5. No author runs or candidate/preflight assessment performed.

blocking_findings.evidence: The protocol requires zero new failures on baseline-passing finals and examples. offline.py only loads each selected run's snapshot-001.json, hashes that one input, and emits pass_count from candidate_pass rows. It neither reads protocol's diagram.architecture.json hashes nor enumerates/runs any examples, and never evaluates primary_gate.
blocking_findings.impact: A holdout summary can report its selected first-pass count while omitting a required no-regression gate. It cannot support the protocol's claim that offline holdout passed or authorize the author gate.
blocking_findings.smallest_repair: Add a separately recorded baseline/candidate comparison for the protocol-defined baseline-passing finals and representative examples, then derive an explicit holdout_gate_pass only when their new-failure count is zero and the other primary_gate clauses pass.

verified_fail_closed_controls.claim: Input overwrite and source/runtime mutation cannot become candidate_pass.
verified_fail_closed_controls.evidence: offline.py copies the frozen input into per-run input.json, rehashes it after the helper, snapshots source/runtime trees, and includes all three booleans in passed. Candidate validation is skipped if any is false.

verified_fail_closed_controls.claim: Malformed candidate output cannot become candidate_pass.
verified_fail_closed_controls.evidence: Output parsing/projection errors are caught; retained remains false, and passed requires retained plus successful showcase validation.

verified_fail_closed_controls.claim: A timed-out or over-cap helper cannot become candidate_pass, and static timing is not author latency.
verified_fail_closed_controls.evidence: run() measures monotonic elapsed time; passed requires helper exit 0 and seconds <= 20 despite a 23-second subprocess timeout. The module and summary explicitly label the result static-only and separate fresh model-author cost.

verified_fail_closed_controls.claim: A holdout helper mismatch is rejected after freeze.
verified_fail_closed_controls.evidence: The holdout path resolves the entrypoint and verifies all frozen candidate files plus protocol SHA before output creation.

focused_validation.command: python3 -m unittest offline_test.py && python3 -m py_compile offline.py
focused_validation.result: 2 semantic-boundary tests passed; syntax compilation passed.

limitations: offline_test.py covers the semantic projection only; it does not exercise the main harness mutation, malformed-output, timeout, or primary-gate paths.
This review did not inspect the still-changing preflight implementation or holdout bytes.

clarification_after_gate_split.status: resolved as a promotion/holdout-qualification claim; original finding remains applicable if a later workflow tries to treat this collector as the full compatibility gate.
clarification_after_gate_split.verified: offline.py now emits first_draft_static_gate_pass as the only positive result it can derive. whole_holdout_gate_pass, ready_for_author_trials, and promotion_qualified are hard-coded false, and required_separate_evidence explicitly lists compatibility, full finalize, independent semantic/common-viewport review, and fresh author/confirmation work.
clarification_after_gate_split.current_study_state: Per the assigned status, revision 1 development scored 0/3, so this collector has not opened holdout or reached compatibility/author stages.
clarification_after_gate_split.remaining_requirement: If a future candidate passes the initial first-draft screen, the separate no-new-failures check for baseline-passing finals and representative examples must still be executed and recorded before whole_holdout_gate_pass can truthfully change.
